blocks.title: Always Official
blocks.tagline: Keeps restarting Official mode in TrackMania United Forever after you entered it once.

items.title: Restart stays official
items.text: Retiring or pressing Improve starts official mode again without the confirmation.

items.title: Inputs carry over
items.text: Input presses are carried over, so you do not have to press them again.

items.title: Offline by default
items.text: A race is still offline until you use Restart in Official Mode.

items.title: Small
items.text: The first C# mod for the TMF ModLoader, built with NativeAOT at a little over 800 kB.

blocks.title: Good to know
blocks.markdown:
Coppers are consumed at the end of the countdown, so this is not a free official mode.

The recommended install is through ModLoader: add the mod server URL from the README under `servers:` in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\TMLoader\config.yaml`. A standalone build with a d3d9.dll proxy also exists, but it can collide with other mods.

blocks.title: Credits
blocks.markdown: Always Official is made by BigBang1112.
